answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 6847 Country: India Title: With reverence and humble submission, In our society ( Jammu & Kashmir , India ) more and more people are joining RCM Bussiness, a commission based business; more details about this can be viewed at here( http://www.rcmbusiness.com/index.aspx ) . Now i want to know is this type of bussiness permisible in Islam. With regards! Question: Dear Scholar Assalamu-Alikum! With reverence and humble submission, In our society ( Jammu & Kashmir , India ) more and more people are joining RCM Bussiness, a commission based business; more details about this can be viewed at here( http://www.rcmbusiness.com/index.aspx ) . Now i want to know is this type of bussiness permisible in Islam. With regards! Answer ID: 6847 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1467/1276=B/1429) The business of RCM Company is not lawful as per the Islamic Shariah. There are several reasons for unlawfulness; therefore Muslims should never participate in such companies. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
